· intro d e he x
    apply matched T W h c R (hr e) (sober_upper (C := C) (e := d) (fun _ => x)) ((hr e).transit d he x)
    intro i
    have hi : Tendsto (fun u => snapshots i d u x) F.fuse (𝓝 (i.core S H x)) :=
      arcing (i.ready H hh d) tendsto_const_nhds
    refine hi.congr' (Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    rintro ⟨N,p⟩
    exact (upper_scan (fun _ => x) i N p).symm

proof_context.conclusion: For `x` at degree `d`, the readouts at degree `e` of the inclusion tend to the target `i.core S H x` (`matched` with `sober_upper`).

· intro d k x
    have hx : sober C (heighten C d x k) F := by
      apply sober_of_cont
      intro N p o
      exact ((C.continuousO N p d x _).sub (C.continuousO N p d x _)).const_smul _
    apply matched T W h c R (hr (d+1)) hx ((hr d).pace x k)
    exact D h hh (Around.size_done h (c.book _ _)) H d x k

proof_context.conclusion: The `heighten` difference of two smeared families is `sober`, and `matched` gives its limit.
